title: Can AI Truly Represent Your Voice in Deliberations? A Comprehensive Study of Large-Scale Opinion Aggregation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'Representativeness Bias' by comparing the representativeness scores assigned to minority opinions versus non-minority (majority) opinions. Minority opinions are identified using two methods: subjectively (via participant self-reporting in surveys) and objectively (via automated semantic outlier detection using embeddings and Local Outlier Factor).

Analyzing the representativeness scores of individual contributions based on their sequential position within the input prompt (e.g., binning positions and plotting trajectories) to determine if the summarization model favors earlier or later comments.
